description: This file contains functions for automating HR-related processes in an ERP system, including payroll processing, leave management, attendance marking, and expense claims.

methods.name: work
methods.description: Main function to automate HR processes including payroll, attendance, leave, and expense claims.

methods.name: get_payroll_entry
methods.description: Creates and returns a payroll entry for the previous month.

methods.name: get_expenses
methods.description: Generates a list of expense claim items with random amounts.

methods.name: update_sanctioned_amount
methods.description: Updates the sanctioned amount for each expense in an expense claim.

methods.name: get_timesheet_based_salary_slip_employee
methods.description: Retrieves employees with salary structures based on timesheets.

methods.name: make_timesheet_records
methods.description: Creates timesheet records, salary slips, and sales invoices for employees.

methods.name: make_salary_slip_for_timesheet
methods.description: Creates and submits a salary slip for a given timesheet.

methods.name: make_sales_invoice_for_timesheet
methods.description: Creates and submits a sales invoice for a given timesheet.

methods.name: make_leave_application
methods.description: Creates leave applications based on leave allocations and balances.

methods.name: mark_attendance
methods.description: Marks attendance for active employees, considering leave applications.

methods.name: setup_department_approvers
methods.description: Sets up leave and expense approvers for departments.
